name: Git
description: Stages, unstages and commits the diagram in its git repository and shows what changed in it since a revision, state by state and transition by transition, as text or side by side in a diff tab. Needs git, and for the text diff the hsm_git modules with the CyberiadaML binding 1.2 in the Python the plugin runs with.

parameters.label: Revision
parameters.description: The commit to compare with: HEAD, HEAD~1, a branch, a tag or a hash

parameters.label: Geometry
parameters.description: Also show the moved and resized elements, the ids and the view state

actions.label: Stage
actions.reason: Save the diagram of a git work tree
actions.description: Add the saved diagram to the index of its repository (git add)

actions.label: Unstage
actions.description: Take the diagram out of the index, its file kept as it is

actions.label: Commit...
actions.description: Commit every staged file of the repository with the message (git commit)

actions.label: Changes Since a Revision...
actions.description: The states, the transitions and the comments changed since the revision, the unsaved edits included

actions.label: Compare with a Revision...
actions.description: The revision and the diagram with its unsaved edits side by side in a diff tab, the changes marked

actions.label: Compare with the Index
actions.description: The staged diagram and the diagram with its unsaved edits side by side in a diff tab: what the commit takes

actions.label: Commit...
actions.description: Show the branch and the staged files, ask the message and commit them all
